balls.text: again full, not allowing Duminy get under the ball, he hits it towards long-on and scampers through for two
full on the pads, and Duminy slog-sweeps, but can't beat deep midwicket, two only
yorker, and just one
lofted shot towards wide long-off, where Dinda over-runs the ball, slips and does well to save the boundary, should have been a boundary
yorker this time, perfect delivery, just a single to cover
slow, full, Duminy goes for the slog-sweep, gets inside edge onto the pad
and he drives well right away, just outside off, and drives with an open face, a diving point fieldsman gets a hand and saves two
Ishant has got his Delhi team-mate, with a short one, extra bounce there, Dhawan looks to make room and cut, and gets a big edge through to McCullum. It's now 6 for 64 after the break
what a shot, Dhawan breaks the shackles, improvising, goes right across the line, and then flicks the slower ball over short fine
goes short again, knows something about his Delhi team-mate? This one is pulled well, though, to wide long-on where Dinda fumbles to allow a two
another dot ball, short ball, and pulled, but can't beat midwicket
short, angling across, and he misses out on the late-cut
steps out, gets to the pitch of the ball, and plays towards long-off
full delivery, sweeps, sweeps well, to the gap in the leg side, two runs
couple for a gap in the off side, drives a fullish delivery
fulltoss and played down to long-on
googly, starts leg, turns away, and defended into the off side, but gets a single
fullish length, topspinner, and defended
another one goes, good bouncer, perfect height, in front of Bravo's face, he hooks, gets a top-edge, Gayle runs back from square leg and takes the catch coolly. Now 51 for 5 from last seven overs
short, on the pads, misses out, but will get a leg-bye
it's just a defensive push, fulltoss, and JP just guides it into the off side, and finds the timing and the gap between sweeper-cover and extra cover
fulltoss, just outside off, and hit straight to mid-off, had this hit direct Bravo was gone
Misses out on a fulltoss now, on the pads, and turned away straight to deep backward square
overpitched, played down to mid-off
fulltoss, and played towards long-on all along the ground
tries the carrom ball, just short of a length, but there is no turn there, and helped away into the off side
too full again, and flicked into the leg side again
full, too full, and flicked away into the leg side
full, spinning in this time, Bravo gets an inside edge

and a run-out right away, quick carrom delivery, takes the pad on the way to short fine, Nayar wants one, but Duminy sends him back. Nayar had taken four steps, yet couldn't make his way back. There was never a run in this, even though Shukla was quite quick
tires the bouncer, Nayar takes a step down, and pulls it in front of square, rolls his wrists over it
full, on pads, turned away towards fine leg
swinging low fulltoss, and Jayasuriya makes room and finds the width, but can't clear Ghosh at point. It just took the toe of the bat, but a special innings from Jaya
Jaya makes room, Shukla follows him, and he misses it, plays all over it
overpitched, on the pads, Duminy goes for the big one, but hits it down the ground to long-on, just a single
yorker to Duminy, and in front of middle, defended back
back of a length, just outside off, and cut away towards point
he has got him with a fulltoss, nice inviting fulltoss on the middle stump, Harbhajan hits it cleanly, but doesn't get the elevation and hits straight to Mendis at deep midwicket
finally a mis-hit, it is shorter than he expects and he ends up top-edging a slog-sweep between midwicket and long-on
ho ho ho, another one, No. 10 for the innings, this is strighter, and is slog-swept way way over midwicket
some of Sachin's timing has rubbed off to Harbhajan. Thrown up, just outside off, and he lofts it over long-off with ease, all timing
full and slow, and hit straight down the ground
beats Harbhajan with a bouncer, he is already pressing forward and misses on the shot
superb yorker, landing inside the crease, in front of middle, there is nothing Harbhajan can do with it
short, into his body, and Harbhajan pulls it off the front foot, clean hit over midwicket
full, and wide, almost a yorker, hit towards mid-off

finally they get a wicket, Tendulkar shuffles a long way, looking to hit a full, incoming delivery into the leg side, and misses. It would have taken the leg stump. Nonetheless what a superb innings, one of the best of this IPL
that's a lucky four, just back of a length, Sachin slashes hard, gets an outside edge that flies towards thirdman boundary, Mendis dives but can't save four
Sachin almost gets out immediately after the break, top-edges a sweep, but it falls in no-man's land
short, sits up, and flicked away to leg side for one
fired in now, cramping Jaya up, he plays it back to the bowler
tries a reverse scoop, the pace is slow, and beats Jaya
flighted, slower, 80ks, and guided expertly between sweeper-cover and thirdman for two, brings up his 50 in 26 balls
full and wide, and Tendulkar sweeps it from way outside off
full, on off stump, swings away a touch, and gets the edge to thirdman
short, around off, and dabbed towards thirdman
slower ball, sees it, and hits it hard towards extra cover, but doesn't get the elevation
looks to go over covers, Shukla pushes it wide, and beats him
shot! lovely hands, on the pads, full, and flciked away, easy four, fine leg is in
full outside off, and driven into the offside
shorter, slower, and pulled away easily for one
short and flat, and Jayasuriya misses out, pulling it straight to deep backward square
full, on the off stump, and played down the ground
goes for the big drive, gets an underside edge, that goes between McCullum's legs, for four, and it's now the highest opening stand during this IPL
almost another reverse flick, gives up the sweep to go for the third man, but can't beat the fielder
short, on the pads, Jayasuriya flicks towards deep square leg
full, on the off stump, no spin, and it's hit down to long-off
fulltoss, scooped towards fine leg, and by the time the fielder gets around, there is enough time for 2
pitched up, on the stumps, and he plays it into the leg side, 100 up, inside 10 overs
Mendis is being taken to pieces, length ball, on the stumps, no turn, and Sachin clears his leg, and plays a little pick-up over midwicket, what a way to reach his 50
carrom ball this time, but there isn't much turn available here, and helped into the leg side easily
he is dismantling his compatriot, reads the googly, and goes with the spin, lofts it over long-off; uff what batting
you beauty Sachin, this is a hockey shot, a reverse flick, this is full, outside off, Tendulkar gives up the scoop shot and opens the face to thirdman
full, on the pads, Jayasuriya connects, but this doesn't beat deep fine leg
heading towards block hole, and plaued with an open face
straight fulltoss, played down to long-on
ho ho, another, short, angled into his pads, and Jauasuriya flick-pulls it over fine leg, this is quite a show, Sanath and Sachin
full, straight, and played down the ground for another single
fuller now, and played down the ground
okay bye Mendis, length ball, looks for the carrom break, but there is no spin, Tendulkar has premeditated a slog sweep, and boy has he connected? It goes way over the midwicket boundary
bowls a toppie, Jaya plays it back, and he fails to get back down in time and it costs him a single
gives himself a bit of room to hit it through the covers
goes in the air, straight down the ground, didn't get hold of it but the good thing was it was stright
carrom ball right away, pitched off and defended
ho ho, that's huge, gentle half-volley on the middle stump, Jaya clears the front leg and launches it way over the midwicket boundary
Ganguly hasn't learned from his mistakes so far, bowls short and on the pads, and pulled away for six over deep backward square
on the pads again, deftle played to the gap between short fine and deep backward square, nice couple
just back of a length, on the pads, and played towards midwicket, back-to-back dots
just back of a length, outside off, moving in, and beats a poke
that's a wide, short one down leg, and Jaya was going for a six there. Just missed
shortish and wide, and dabbed it towards thirdman
back of a length, around off, Tendulkar moves across and nudges it into the on side
slower ball, nelson ks, but short and wide, yet manages to put Tendulkar off timing
fuller on the stumps, that's the length to ball, and defended straight back
uff, shades of Andy Caddick there from the 2003 world cup, short and wide, chest high, Sachin goes leg side, and pulls it with ease, smooth over midwicket
shorter, just outside off, and Tendulkar doesn't get the room to cut
yorks Tendulkar, and played towards midwicket
that's picked from in front of middle, and flicked away fine, what a shot, length ball, on the stumps, but Jayasuriya manages to get it fine - his short-arm flick
full, outside off, and Tendulkar drives, uppishly, but pretty straight, Ganguly dives to save the four
one short ball too many, Tendulkar rocks back, deliberately goes in the air, and clears point easily
lucky to get away, short and wide, the slight seam movement beats a Tendulkar cut

Jayasuriya steps out, makes room, Dinda tries the bouncer, he still hits, looking to go over extra, Hodge jumps high and gets a hand to it. Saves four. Anureet SIngh runs from mid-off, that's good news that Anureet is back
back of a length, starting middle and angling across, defended off the front foot
slight error in length, and is punished, it's short and wide, but bouncing, but Tendulkaer gets on the top of the bounce, and caresses it between point and cover
another full, inswinger, Tendulkar waits for it to move and then drives it stright down the ground, but can't beat mid-on
big inswinger, he has finally got his wrist and release right, this was full, started outside off, beat Tendulkar and would have missed leg
fuller, Tendulkar looks to flick, misses, and the angle saves him there
good ball, good shot, short and wide as it started, but nipped back in. A cramped up Tendulkar still manages to cut it, but can't beat cover
another wide, down the leg side again
perfect, back of a length, just outside off, holding its line, and beating the outside edge
five wides there, wide down leg, moving away, and McCullum has no chance. The wrist broke too early as he bowled that
bowls short and wide, and is cut through the point region for one to thirdman
there wasn't much wrong with this delivery, just back of a length, on the middle stump, Sachin rocks back, waits for the ball to come on, and flicks late, through square leg
short again, but no room for Sachin to cut, pushed towards cover
poor delivery, short and wide, and moving away
just back of a length, nipping in, cramping Sachin up, and defended into the leg side
short and wide, but he misses out this time
Tendulkar is 36 years young, makes room, it's short on the stumps, and upper-cuts it, over point, and hits the rope on the full
fuller, on the pads, fast, and Jayasuriya defends into the on side
short angling across, 136ks, plays with an open face, towards point

lovely flick from in front of his stumps, to deep backward square leg. Anureet runs from deep fine and makes the stop, but twists his ankle in doing so. Visible pain there. Big blow if he can't bowl. Limping off the field now
fuller, but he has pushed Sachin into the crease, plays defensively
lovely delivery, back of a length, holds its line, beats a poke from Tendulkar, a taste of what Ponting faced in Australia
full, almost a yorker, Jaya gives it his all, gets an inside edge and goes for one to fine leg

leg stump again, it's all over, Malinga can't go for the hat-trick because Anureet Singh won't bat. This was a perfect yorker, full, fast, low, base of leg stump, Dinda saves the toe, little mercy that

team-mate to team-mate, and what a beauty, Malinga is already backing away looking to save his toes, but Malinga bowls an accurate slower delivery, 100ks, there is nothing defending the stumps here, and the leg stump goes out
Ishant makes room, and hits his opening partner through the covers, but too little too late

good judgement from Jayasuriya, at the long-on boundary, this was a length delivery on the stumps and Shukla got under it, clean shot but doesn't have the power to to clear long-on, where Jayasuriya takes an overhead catch, inches inside the boundary
short, into the boyd, and turned away with one hand
again he makes room, Zaheer follows him, and Shukla gets an inside edge through to the keeper, Shah
Shukla backs away again, and misses again, it goes over the stumps and Shukla misses completely
back of a length, gets rib-high for Ishant, he drops his wrists and takes a single to cover
makes room again, does Shukla, Bravo follows him with a short delivery, Shukla sees it, pulls, connects and clears midwicket, it falls inches inside the boundary
makes room again, and he beats him from the other side this time, slower ball, outside off, and is too wide for Shukla to hit
makes room, Bravo sees it, drags it back, gets it chest high, and Shukla misses
short of a length, outside off, and driven on the up through the covers
Kolkata are falling apart now, end is nigh, Bravo bowls just back of a length, and Yashpal looks to go over extra cover, and edges faintly
strays down the pads, and flicked away
another dot ball, again beats the outside edge, this one was a striaght delivery but Shukla played inside the line
short and straight, beats the bat by getting it to hold the line
straight, length, and defended with open face
Oh my Ghosh, he has flicked it straight to short midiwcket, Sachin Tendulkar. This is soft, really soft. Straight delivery, flicked in the air and an easy catch to Sachin
back of a length, outside off, and pushed wide of mid-off
Ganguly has flown it to the moon and back, makes room to hit it over cover, but this is a stright delivery, top-edges it way into the air, and Bravo takes an easy catch at cover
thrown up on the pads, goes for the heave but can't get the elevation, getting a single to long-on
flipper, rapid one, and Yashpal is late into the pull, but manages to clear midwicket
thrown up, offbreak, just outside leg, Ganguly looks for a big heave, gets the inside half and a single to long-on
full, outside leg, paddle-swept away for a single
off break, back of a length, pitches just outside off, and spins towards stumps, played down for a single
length ball on the stumps, and flicked for an easy single
Yashpal almost runs Ganguly out, back nof a length, played to mid-off, Ganguly wants one but is sent back, and there is no throw from the fielder. Ganguly perhaps gestures he thought he had hit wider
length delivery, just outside off, and forced through the off side
length ball, angling across, Ganguly gets on the front foot and plays it down the ground
short, into the pads, and dabbed away towards fine leg

plays all around it, it was a length ball, stright, there for the big shot, but Hodge plays an unnatural shot, looking to go over midwicket, and misses, exposing the middle stump. Another one bites the dust immediately after the break
back of a lnegth, angling across, hit with an open face towards sweeper-cover
full offbreak, on the pads, and a single down to long-on
slower offbreak, just outside off, and Hodge guides it towards midwicket
Ganguly looks to step down, Sachin slows it down, just back of a length, and Ganguly stays back, and plays towards point
slower on the pads, and Hodge takes a single to midwidket
legbreak, full, fields to his right, almost collides with Ganguly
bowls an offbreak back of a elngth, just outside leg, and an easy single to leg

just back of a length, outside off, will be a single to the left of point. And Ganguly signals for a drink, with just one over to go to strategy break. That break is perhaps only for strategy, and not drinks
back of a length, angling across, gets a dot ball, it was played with an open face but straight towards point
full again, on the stumps, and driven down to long-on
short, wide, angling across, and Ganguly plays with an open face, an easy single to thirdman
another half-volley outside off, but this time he goes squarer and gets a single to sweeper-point
keeper up, half-volley outside off, and a perfecdt cricketing shot, superb cover drive all along the ground
flat, fired into his pads, 96ks, and a single down to long-on
slower, around the off stump, he plays it in front of his pad and gets a single to cover
fulltoss, outside off, and Ganguly plays it with an open face, beats point and gets two
slowed it down, but it's too short, Hodge pulls it to wide of long-on
bowls full again, no time for it to turn, and Ganguly drives it with an open face
full, just outside off, and a single down to long-off
slower ball, 123ks, full, on the stumps, Ganguly plays in front of his body, and back to Zaheer
full, just outside off, and Ganguly plays with an open face
comes down too early, Zaheer bowls a bouncer, and a limp single to midwicket
back on target now, no room, swigning in, on a length
good shot, wasn't short enough, Hodge goes back and late-cuts it, superb timing, but Harbhajan runs fast from thirdman to stop the boundary, it took a dive
swings in a touch, length, middle, and Hodge defends

mindgames, mindgames, Ganguly looks to make room and shorten his nlength, Harbhajan pushes one through and short, Ganguly goes for the cut, but this is fairly quick, at 99ks, and beats the outside edge. Stares
cramps him up, tospinner again, no room, another dot
poor fielding by Tendulkar, fulltoss hit straight to cover, but he doesn't get down in time, letting it go through him
tospinner again, but short, Ganguly goes back, makes room and cuts it through the covers
another dot, full outside off, and played straight to cover
bowls a topspinner right away, gets an inside edge into the ground
poor delivery, short, angling down the leg side, Hidge gets his body inside the line, and pulls it fine, fine of fine leg
slower offcutter, opens the face towards point, and gets a single
ho ho Dadi of the old, steps out again, makes room again, gets to the pitch and lofts it over mid-off, clean, very clean
shot, vintage Ganguly, steps down, amkes room, picks the bouncer and crashes it through the off side
full, angled across, no foot movement from ganguly, and plays it striaght to mid-off
short, on the pads, Ganguly gets across to play it down towards midwicket
bowls the same length, but straighter, tucking Hodge up
top shot, shortish and wide outside off, Hodge lets it come to him, plays on the up, and forces it through the covers, head still, crunchy sound, perfect shot
back of a length again, on the pads, and helped away towards deep fine leg
attacking the short length again, angling in to the pad, and gets a single to wide of mid-on
just back of a length again, wide of off, and played with an open face
that's sharp pace, 142ks, but seems faster than that, gets lovely bounce ffrom just back of a length, beats Hodge and goes chest high to Pinal, still climbing

there's only one West Indian smiling now, and it's not Gayle. What a revenge for that clubbed six, he gets this to get big on Gayle, short angling across, Gayle looks to push it, but the extra bounce takes the edge, which flies to the sole slip, the wide slip

how close was that? and that only because it is Bravo. the ball holds on again, Gayle checks the shot, and it's flying towards the other end of the pitch from Bravo, who dives, nay flies, and gets a hand to it
ful;l, wide, looks to drive, but there is just enough movement to get an inside-edge
short and wide, and Duminy saves four at point, diving to his right
short again, angling across Gayle, he pushes it into the off side for one
goes back over, and bowls a short one down the leg side
and Gayle despatches fellow West Indian for the 150th six of the tournament. A gentle half-tracker, Gayle clears the leg, and a home run over midwicket, and he points in that direction after hitting

Malinga strikes, strikes big, just back of a length, seems it held on to the surface a bit, McCullum is checks the shot, but hits it in the air towards point, and Duminy takes a low catch in front of him
tries to bounce. McCullum gets on his toes to cut it straight into the ground, and then through to point
wide and short, seaming away, and left alone
back on the money, on the pads, full, just a single to deep backward square

never ever seen anything like this, tries a slower delivery, 96ks, and it's so wide the keeper can't run across to it despite having ample time, it's like about 10 pitches width away, and it's so slow the fine leg can get around to stop a boundary
another yorker, 141ks, Gayle plays towards cover and almost limps through for one, limps because Zaheer hit him on the toe last over
yorker right away, swinging in, uff what a start, Gayle saves his toe by getting the bat down in time
yorker again, he digs it out towards midwicket, and gets a single
Gayle goes aerial, and misconnects, over-pitched, gets the toe, looking to go over mid-off, but still clears the fielder, and gets two
moving in towards Gayle's pads, just outside off, and Gayle plays in front of his pads
gets a yorker first-up, just outside off, 138ks, and plays inside the line
length delivery, driven just to wide of mid-off, single, 137ks
back of a length, angling across, lets it go, there won't be many more such
